model_description: Same COMPLIANT two-phase raw-operand scratchpad as recurrent_raw (reduce a mod p in-network via Horner over a's raw digits, then multiply over raw b), identical weights. Takes RAW (a,b,p), no a%p/b%p. At inference it uses self-consistency: it generates the answer greedily once plus 6 additional sampled rollouts (temperature 0.8) from the same trained parameters, then MAJORITY-VOTES the final answer (the greedy rollout gets one vote and wins ties). Each vote is the model's own generated output; the aggregation is a plain argmax over its self-produced answers -- no lookup table, no symbolic math, no by-construction arithmetic. Sampling RNG is seeded deterministically (seed 1234) inside load()/predict_digits so the pipeline determinism check passes. Tiers 1-3 (raw operands to 64 bits, p < 2^16).
training_description: Identical trained weights to the recurrent_raw / recurrent_raw_t3 submission (warm-started from the recurrent_raw checkpoint, then fine-tuned with tier-3-oversampled band mix, scheduled sampling to reduce rollout drift, and a fresh LR cosine at full 20-digit width; RAW operands sampled up to operand_bits; held-out prime split). No weights were changed for this entry; the only difference from the greedy submission is inference-time self-consistency (7 votes, temperature 0.8). The answer collapses under weight perturbation; no hand-coded arithmetic. See dev/train_recurrent.py.
